abstract: Covers CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE): Structures and Process. RFC 9052 CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE): Structures and Process is current; RFC 9053 CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE): Initial Algorithms is current; RFC 9360 CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE): Header Parameters for Carrying and Referencing X.509 Certificates is current; RFC 9964 ML-DSA for JSON Object Signing and Encryption (JOSE) and CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE) is current. Requirements are quotes from the pinned text. SKILL.md holds the workflow; references split versions and the quoted requirements.
